subject.title: RFC 0009: align Hosted Feed v1 specifications

question: Should this repository adopt the proposed Hosted Feed v1 publisher, DSSE, sharding, query, delta, and notification contract as the normative cross-repository interface before the linked OpenClaw and ClawHub implementation PRs land?
rationale: The PR establishes new compatibility and trust semantics across repositories; neither static RFC review nor contributor-only comparisons can decide the permanent public contract.

options.title: Approve after interoperability proof
options.body: Confirm the proposed contract direction after a redacted final-head OpenClaw–ClawHub interoperability artifact proves the signed projection and refresh paths.

options.title: Narrow the RFC
options.body: Adopt only the core signed publisher snapshot contract now and defer query, delta, notification, and durable-inbox semantics to separately approved addenda.

options.title: Pause for broader protocol review
options.body: Hold the RFC until the relevant OpenClaw and ClawHub owners agree on the upgrade and trust boundaries in the linked implementation work.

recommendation.title: Approve after interoperability proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the proposed contract direction after a redacted final-head OpenClaw–ClawHub interoperability artifact proves the signed projection and refresh paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed person connected to both this RFC and the cross-referenced Hosted Feed implementation sequence; repository ownership history could not be inspected.
